title: recommendReachingPath (goal-host-vessel index.ts ~5720-5764) sorts shape_signature-matched candidates by successful_exec
description: recommendReachingPath (goal-host-vessel index.ts ~5720-5764) sorts shape_signature-matched candidates by successful_executions descending and deterministically picks eligible[0] -- no Thompson sampling, no signal for whether a pathway carries a deterministic verifier. Live-confirmed via direct POST to activity-api /v2/goal-paths/recommend (undispatched probe goal, target_shapes:["shellResult"]): a generic composition (path_activities=["satisfier:shellResult"], 4/4 reached) outranks the citation-oracle-verified universal-tool-fallback floor pathway (3/3 reached, backed by verifyCodeInvestigationCitation, commit 5e4d045) by exactly one execution. Both rows ARE indexed and retrievable -- this rules out an unindexed-row bug. Reproduced live in dispatch 50f7fc4c (code-investigation goal for symbol TranslatingTraceSink): the top-ranked generic composition was tried first, cited the wrong file, was correctly caught HOLLOW by the citation oracle (deterministic:code-investigation-citation-unverified), re-framed shapes, tried auto-bridge-codeSearchResult (also HOLLOW), then finally fell through to a fresh universalToolFallback derivation which reached. Consequence: a pathway's own verifiedness never factors into reuse ranking, so a correctly-oracled pathway can only overtake a generic one via execution-count attrition from repeated beta-penalized failures, wasting 2 extra walk-steps on every affected investigation goal until that attrition completes. Suggested repair direction, not prescribed: weight the sort in recommendReachingPath (or server-side in activity-api's /v2/goal-paths/recommend, which already computes confidence/thompson_params) by success_rate and/or a verifier-presence signal instead of raw successful_executions count. Audit other shape families before changing the tie-break -- they may depend on current raw-count behavior.
